_description: spec/VERIFICATION.md V2-2, site by site: a maximal schema-valid instance (the signed wiring base plus schema-only members) and single changes to it, each naming the IR assertion site(s) it breaks and the error both oracles must report (attribution: the instance pointer and keyword, or the enclosing oneOf). A case applies mutation (set the value at path, delete the member at path, or add count members x_unknown_NN at the root) to the instance, or raw_replace ([from, to], one occurrence) to JSON.stringify(instance) and parses the result. These are SCHEMA expectations only: the changes touch committed content without signing it again, so no case here is a full-verification case (see wiring_cases.json). Expectations come from oracle 1 (Ajv + upstream ajv-formats) and oracle 2 (python-jsonschema with two disclosed test adapters), never from the IR evaluator under test.
